scope_notes.label: Historical composite and variable eastward pathways
scope_notes.source_locator: Publisher-indexed abstract and Introduction; author repository abstract. Historical comparison: Tilburg et al. (2001), Introduction, journal p. 2918, Figure 2 caption p. 2919.
scope_notes.summary: Historical composite paths combine different years and observation methods. A 2019 reassessment finds multiple pathways and questions a persistent narrow front across the central Tasman Sea. The 32–36 S meander band is not current width. A single dated axis, whole-current length and annual ranges remain unresolved.
